title: The only screen test of Help and feedback runs in the demo gym, where that page is replaced
what: The one browser test that types and sends a message in Help and feedback starts the demo gym first. In the demo the app swaps that page for a 'needs a real gym' note with no message box, so the test cannot reach the box it fills: it either fails every run or is not really run. The demo's More list also still shows the Help and feedback row, though the journey says the demo must not offer it. The AI answer box, 'Did this solve it?' and 'Your questions' are never seen on a screen.
expected: The test signs in to an online gym (owner and staff), sends a question, sees the AI answer with its label and Yes/No, and checks 'Your questions'. A second check that the demo gym does not offer the page.
fix_line: Move the help test to an online gym and add the answer, rating and history checks

title: The GST journey and the GST tests disagree on what old receipts show
what: The journey says that once a gym adds its GSTIN an old receipt shows a tax split, and that removing the GSTIN takes the tax lines off. The tests lock the opposite: a receipt keeps the GST state of the day it was taken, so an old receipt stays plain and a registered one keeps its tax. The tests look right for tax law; the journey lines are wrong, so anyone working from the journey would change the wrong thing.
expected: One rule, the same in the journey and the tests: a receipt shows tax only if the gym was registered on the day of the sale.
fix_line: Correct the old-receipt lines in the GST journey

title: The workout report card on a member's page is never opened in a screen test
what: The server rules and the words of the 'Full workout history' card are tested as data, but no browser test opens a member's page, taps 'Request workout report', sees 'Asking...', the waiting line, the green sent line or 'Download full history', or opens the downloaded file.
expected: A screen test asks for a report, sees each state's line and button, downloads the file and checks a second tap sends no second ask.
fix_line: Add a screen test of the workout report card

title: A failed or half-saved backup download, and staff being kept from it, are never tested
what: Tests only check a download that works. Nothing checks the words when the file cannot be made, that the last-download day does not move after a failure, that a half-saved pair is not called a success, that a double tap starts one download, or that front desk staff get no 'Download a backup' card with every member's phone and address.
expected: Tests make the download fail, save only one file, tap twice, and sign in as staff to see no card.
fix_line: Add failure, double-tap and staff checks to the backup test

title: The Refresh line's hidden tab, busy tap and demo hiding are never tested
what: Tests check the age words and one good and one failed Refresh for the owner. Nothing checks that a tab hidden for minutes reads again when shown and stops reading while hidden, that a second tap while busy starts no second read, that 'Refreshing...' never sticks, or that the demo gym shows no Refresh line. No test signs in as staff for it.
expected: Tests hide and show the tab, tap Refresh twice fast, and open the demo gym to see no line.
fix_line: Add hidden-tab, double-tap and demo checks to the Refresh test

title: Set up your gym's 'Next step' bar and undoing a hand tick are never tested
what: Tests open steps from the list and use 'Back to the list', but never check the 'Next step: ...' bar, that it skips done steps, or that it is missing on screens not opened from the list. Nothing checks that a hand tick can be taken back.
expected: A test follows 'Next step' through two steps and unticks a hand-ticked step.
fix_line: Add the Next step bar and untick to the setup test
